wa_south_face_4_sunrise_express.notes: SCOPE (as asked): Sunrise Express is its OWN line, not a pitch or variation of Dod's Jam, Steppenwolf or Right Gull. Mountain Project starts it about 20 ft left of Young Warriors (wa_young_warriors) at the Southeast Corner, and the main line ends at its own two-bolt anchor; two optional variations (5.6 left, 5.4 right) exit onto Young Warriors P2, the right one to the Young Warriors P2 belay. It never meets Dod's Jam, Steppenwolf or Right Gull, which sit in the tunnel areas further west. Sunrise direct (wa_south_face_4_sunrise_direct) is a variation of THIS route. theCrag's Beacon Rock South Face sectors (Southeast Corner, First/Second/Third Tunnel, Young Warriors) were read in Chrome 2026-11-24 and do not list this route, so Mountain Project is the only publisher found.

wa_south_face_4_north_country.notes: OVERLAP: P1 is Free for All Direct (wa_free_for_all_direct; MP grades it 5.8/10a), P2 is Dod's Jam's 10c pitch (wa_south_face_4_dod_s_dastardly_jam) to Big Ledge, then the route's own 5.13c slab pitch and an 11b pitch past The Norseman's (wa_the_norseman) anchors, and a 5.7 pitch to the top.
